phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 1 caption (SPME.tex lines 132-136)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: This is a conceptual schematic of CDW memory, cloud expansion, and a mobility edge, not an independently plotted numerical result.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The schematic illustrates localized, intermediate, and extended dynamical regimes.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: No numerical object; conceptual diagram only.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 2(a) caption and discussion (SPME.tex lines 161-169)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Experimental FWHM cloud-size time traces distinguish extended, intermediate, and localized detuning strengths at Vp=4 Erp.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: Experimental cloud expansion is rapid at Vd=0, slower at Vd=0.57 Erp, and absent at Vd=1.04 Erp over the plotted time range.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: FWHM sigma(t) for Vd in {0, 0.57, 1.04} Erp at Vp=4 Erp, including experimental uncertainties.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 2(b) caption and discussion (SPME.tex lines 161-169)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Edge density D=1-Nc/N is a numerical transport observable for particles leaving the initially occupied center third.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: Numerical edge density rises rapidly at Vd=0, more slowly and to a lower value at Vd=0.57 Erp, and remains near zero at Vd=1.04 Erp, eventually saturating because of finite system size.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: D(t) for Vd in {0, 0.57, 1.04} Erp at Vp=4 Erp through 3000 tau.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 3(a) caption (SPME.tex lines 177-181)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Experimental imbalance at 200 tau and expansion at 3000 tau are jointly plotted against detuning for Vp=4 Erp.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: At Vp=4 Erp the measured imbalance onset precedes loss of expansion, leaving an intermediate detuning interval where both are finite.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Experimental I(Vd,200 tau) and E(Vd,3000 tau), six-phase mean and SEM, at Vp=4 Erp.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 3(b) caption (SPME.tex lines 177-181)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Experimental imbalance and expansion locate two phase boundaries at Vp=6 Erp.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: At Vp=6 Erp a finite, narrower intermediate interval remains between imbalance onset and expansion loss.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Experimental I(Vd,200 tau) and E(Vd,3000 tau), six-phase mean and SEM, at Vp=6 Erp.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 3(c) caption (SPME.tex lines 177-181)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Experimental imbalance and expansion locate two phase boundaries at Vp=8 Erp.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: At Vp=8 Erp the measured intermediate interval remains finite but is narrower and shifted to lower detuning.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Experimental I(Vd,200 tau) and E(Vd,3000 tau), six-phase mean and SEM, at Vp=8 Erp.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 3(d) caption and discussion (SPME.tex lines 177-181, 201-204)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Stationary continuum numerics at Vp=4 Erp compare central-tube dashed curves with atom-weighted tube-averaged solid curves for imbalance and edge density.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: At Vp=4 Erp I crosses upward and D crosses downward through 0.015 at separated detunings; tube averaging broadens the interval, especially through D.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Central-tube and tube-averaged I(Vd), D(Vd), plus their 0.015 crossings at Vp=4 Erp.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 3(e) caption and discussion (SPME.tex lines 177-181, 201-204)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Stationary continuum numerics at Vp=6 Erp compare central-tube and tube-averaged localization observables.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: At Vp=6 Erp the separated 0.015 crossings define a narrower intermediate interval, broadened by tube averaging.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Central-tube and tube-averaged I(Vd), D(Vd), plus their 0.015 crossings at Vp=6 Erp.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 3(f) caption and discussion (SPME.tex lines 177-181, 201-208)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Stationary continuum numerics at Vp=8 Erp test the tight-binding-limit collapse of the single-tube interval and its tube-averaged broadening.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: At Vp=8 Erp the central-tube intermediate interval is essentially absent, while tube averaging produces a finite apparent interval.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Central-tube and tube-averaged I(Vd), D(Vd), plus their 0.015 crossings at Vp=8 Erp.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 4 main panel caption and text (SPME.tex lines 186-190, 204-208)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The tube-averaged numerical 0.015 crossings define lower and upper phase-boundary curves across Vp.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 4 experimental points and caption (SPME.tex lines 186-190, 204-205)

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main Fig. 4 inset caption and text (SPME.tex lines 186-190, 205-208)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The inset isolates central-tube numerical boundaries without transverse tube averaging.

phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Central-tube VI(Vp), VD(Vp), and width VD-VI for Vp=3 through 8 Erp.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Supplement Fig. S1(a) caption and text (SPME.tex lines 254-269)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: FWHM time traces for a Gaussian-envelope Wannier product state test expansion without a trap.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Supplement Fig. S1(b) caption and text (SPME.tex lines 254-271)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Edge density provides a stable expansion diagnostic for the Gaussian initial state without a trap.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: Without a trap, edge density preserves the extended > intermediate > localized expansion ordering and is smoother than FWHM.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: D(t) for the four S1 detunings at Vp=4 Erp, L=369, no trap.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Supplement Fig. S1(c) caption and text (SPME.tex lines 254-271)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The plotted root-mean-square radius is an all-site cloud-size diagnostic without a trap.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: Without a trap, sqrt(<r^2>)(t) preserves the extended > intermediate > localized expansion ordering and is smoother than FWHM.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Dimensionally correct RMS radius versus time for the four S1 detunings at Vp=4 Erp, L=369, no trap.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Supplement Fig. S1(d) caption and weak-trap discussion (SPME.tex lines 254-257, 284-288)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: FWHM time traces test sensitivity to a 3.5 Hz weak harmonic trap whose edge potential is about 0.003 Erp.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The weak trap strongly perturbs extended/intermediate FWHM dynamics but does not create expansion in the localized case.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: FWHM(t) for the four S1 detunings at Vp=4 Erp, L=369, omega=2pi*3.5 Hz.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Supplement Fig. S1(e) caption and weak-trap discussion (SPME.tex lines 254-257, 284-288)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Edge density time traces test whether weak confinement changes the qualitative expansion classification.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: With the weak trap, edge density is modified in extended/intermediate cases but still preserves expansion in delocalized regimes and negligible expansion when localized.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: D(t) for the four S1 detunings at Vp=4 Erp, L=369, omega=2pi*3.5 Hz.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Supplement Fig. S1(f) caption and weak-trap discussion (SPME.tex lines 254-257, 284-288)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: RMS-radius time traces test whether weak confinement changes the qualitative expansion classification.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: With the weak trap, sqrt(<r^2>)(t) is modified in extended/intermediate cases but preserves the qualitative localization ordering.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Dimensionally correct RMS radius versus time for the four S1 detunings at Vp=4 Erp, L=369, omega=2pi*3.5 Hz.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Supplement RMS definition (SPME.tex line 266)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: A root-mean-square radius must have units of length and equal the square root of the normalized second spatial moment.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The paper prints sqrt(<r^2>) = sum_i (i-i_c)^2 <n_i>.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Dimensional and limiting-case evaluation of the printed RMS equation versus sqrt(sum_i (i-i_c)^2 n_i / sum_i n_i).

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Supplement Fig. S2 theoretical curves and caption (SPME.tex lines 297-306)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Tube-averaged numerical imbalance and edge density at 3000 tau test finite-time bias in the experimental 200 tau imbalance.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: At Vp=4 Erp the 3000 tau tube-averaged numerical imbalance and edge density delimit the same intermediate regime and agree with experiment in extended/localized limits.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Tube-averaged I(Vd,3000 tau) and D(Vd,3000 tau) at Vp=4 Erp.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Supplement Fig. S2 experimental data and discussion (SPME.tex lines 297-306)
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The experimental 200 tau imbalance is compared with the 3000 tau theory curve to estimate bath/finite-time bias.

phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Experimental I(Vd,200 tau), uncertainty, fit, and residual to the 3000 tau tube-averaged numerical curve.

falsification_attempts.method: Set n_i=1 at a single site displaced by d=2 and zero elsewhere; compare dimensions and values.

direct_cause.statement: The printed right-hand side is a second spatial moment with units of site squared, while the left-hand side is an RMS radius with units of site.

root_cause.statement: The supplement's displayed RMS definition omits the outer square root (and leaves normalization implicit); dimensional analysis and a one-site limiting case falsify the printed equality.

code_fault_assessment.statement: Independent algebra, a limiting case, an independent direct-moment evaluation, parameter/provenance audit, and manual code review all agree that the reproduction correctly uses the square root; no reproduction-code fault explains the printed equation.

checks.statement: The equation claim has no tunable physical parameters; site index carries length units and density normalization is explicit in the reconstructed formula.
The RMS definition is exactly sqrt(sum_i (i-i_c)^2 n_i / sum_i n_i).
A direct second-moment evaluation independent of the reproduction path returns the square root of the normalized moment, not the moment itself.
For a normalized cloud concentrated at displacement d, RMS must be |d|; the printed right-hand side gives d^2.
cloud_observables computes the normalized second moment followed by np.sqrt, consistent with the independent derivation.

alternative_hypotheses.statement: The implementation contains the missing square root and normalization, and its limiting behavior agrees with the standard RMS definition.

affected_scope.summary: The candidate concerns the printed RMS method equation used to interpret Supplement Fig. S1(c,f), not the Hamiltonian or the other four S1 panels.
affected_scope.completion: 1/1 printed equation independently falsified; numerical curve fidelity remains separately inconclusive.

next_discriminating_test.action: Obtain an author clarification or erratum confirming the intended normalized square-root formula.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: Author confirmation would promote the typographical-error candidate to a documented erratum without changing the independently derived correction.

discrepancy.paper_claim: The supplement prints sqrt(<r^2>) equal to the unrooted second moment sum_i (i-i_c)^2 <n_i>.
discrepancy.independent_result: RMS is the square root of the normalized second moment; a cloud at displacement d has RMS |d|.
discrepancy.observed_gap: The printed right-hand side has units of site squared and gives d^2 in the one-site limit, whereas the left-hand side has units of site and must give |d|.
discrepancy.uncertainty_or_tolerance_basis: This is an exact algebraic and dimensional contradiction with zero numerical tolerance; no floating-point, device, or sampling choice can remove it.

claim_reviews.assessment_reason: The reduced finite-time theory preserves rising imbalance and falling edge density, but its tube average is a proxy and no paper-scale attested 3000-tau curve is frozen.

independent_checks.independence_basis: The reviewer evaluated central and proxy-averaged series separately from the frozen data rather than treating their visual overlap as evidence.
independent_checks.claim: The reduced 3000-tau central and proxy theory curves show imbalance increasing and edge density decreasing over detuning.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The frozen proxy is the unique author-equivalent tube average and constitutes a paper-scale S2 theory reproduction.
falsification_attempts.method: Audit central and tube-proxy thresholds separately and trace every averaging input to the publication.

direct_cause.statement: The exact atom-weighted per-tube depth distribution, beam/cloud alignment, Gaussian-width convention, and discrete tube weights needed for the paper's solid tube-averaged series are not published.

root_cause.statement: The central-tube Hamiltonian is specified, but the author-equivalent tube average is not uniquely reconstructible from approximate waists and cloud widths; the frozen Gauss-Hermite construction is explicitly a proxy.

code_fault_assessment.statement: The proxy quadrature is internally normalized and scientifically motivated, but no attested paper-scale campaign excludes code defects and no code check can turn the proxy into the unpublished author histogram.

checks.statement: The source audit separates quoted waists (150, 42, and 12 micrometres) from the missing histogram, alignment, and width convention.
The implementation applies correlated depth scaling and normalized atom-weighted Gauss-Hermite quadrature without reading source pixels or author arrays.
The frozen bundle contains only reduced/smoke data and no paper-scale isolated-run attestation.

alternative_hypotheses.statement: Even for the central-tube component, production/convergence evidence is not frozen; this independent evidence gap remains in addition to the publication-input gap.

affected_scope.summary: The central-tube qualitative trend is separately visible, but the panel's tube-averaged numerical curve and exact boundary are not uniquely reproducible.
affected_scope.completion: Central reduced trend checked; 0/1 author-equivalent tube-averaged series.

next_discriminating_test.action: Acquire the authors' per-tube atom/depth histogram and width/alignment convention, then run the frozen production/convergence campaign without changing the physical model.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: The supplied distribution would decide whether the proxy broadening agrees with the author-equivalent solid curve.

claim_reviews.assessment_reason: The exact S2 experimental 200-tau imbalance points, uncertainties, and fit are not available as machine-readable data; only their plotted comparison and prose interpretation are frozen.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The full experimental values, uncertainties, and fit inputs are numerically specified in the frozen paper sources.
falsification_attempts.method: Full-text and source-table trace without image digitization.

direct_cause.statement: The frozen paper provides plotted experimental points but no machine-readable shot-level values, fitted-point table, or uncertainties from which the exact series can be independently reconstructed without using source pixels.

root_cause.statement: Exact numerical reproduction of this experimental series is publication-underspecified because the required measurement table and acquisition-level data are not published in the frozen sources.

code_fault_assessment.statement: No reproduction program can establish the exact experimental measurements from absent raw observations; this limitation is upstream of numerical code.

checks.statement: The full text and source captions were traced and contain only plotted experimental results and prose fit descriptions, not the underlying numerical table.

alternative_hypotheses.statement: An alternative simulation cannot recreate the realized experimental samples and their SEM; changing the numerical method would not supply the missing observations.

affected_scope.summary: Exact experimental points, error bars, and fitted boundaries for this frozen item are not independently reproducible.
